Calling all CW operators! Looking for testers for CW Buddy, By SV1TEU.

I've been developing **CW Buddy**, an open-source, browser-based toolkit for amateur radio CW operators, now on *v2.0*

I'm looking for experienced CW operators and anyone interested in CW to put it through its paces and help me improve it.

I'm particularly interested in feedback on:
- Real-world CW decoding performance.
- Different sending speeds and signal conditions.
- Usability during actual radio operation.
- Bugs, suggestions and ideas for new features.

🌐 Try it here: https://cw-buddy.sv1teu.me

💻 Open source: https://github.com/gethanos/SV1TEU-CW-Buddy

No installation required. Just open it in your browser and give it a try!

Whether you're a seasoned CW operator or just getting started, your feedback is welcome.

73 de Thanos, SV1TEU 

#HamRadio #AmateurRadio #CW #MorseCode #OpenSource
